implementation_semantics_frozen_before_r.missing_local: local amount is unknown in integer [0,cap]; node model-rate class remains known because hidden model attribution is a separate evidence state
implementation_semantics_frozen_before_r.hidden_model_attribution: local amount is exact; rate class may be any of {1,2,4}
implementation_semantics_frozen_before_r.laminarflow: exact specialized min/max-cost-flow solver exploiting laminar exact-sum regions; no heuristic approximation
implementation_semantics_frozen_before_r.evidencemilp: binary ambiguity MILP solved exactly by branch-and-bound over 1-2 binary variables; each laminar integer subproblem is solved exactly by LaminarFlow
implementation_semantics_frozen_before_r.duplicate_distinct_group: one observed usage record of amount a and rate r is certain; binary d=0 means the second observation is duplicate (one charge), d=1 means distinct attempt (two charges); contribution=a*r*(1+d)
implementation_semantics_frozen_before_r.correction_branch_group: exactly one of two mutually exclusive replacement branches is effective; binary d selects branch 0 or branch 1 and its amount/rate charge
implementation_semantics_frozen_before_r.ambiguity_groups: 1 group if seeded Bernoulli<0.5 else 2; each group type selected seeded 50/50; all group parameters generated from the frozen RNG only

subtest_C.base_laminar_generator: same rules as Subtest B except n sampled uniformly from {3,4,5}

subtest_D.q_rule: cap chosen first; q sampled uniformly as integer in [0,cap]
